ideas.pitch: A gamified interactive puzzle platform that teaches school students algorithmic logic and flowchart creation through narrative problem-solving.
ideas.title: LogicalLabyrinth
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted precisely at beginner school students to demonstrate logical reasoning and creative problem-solving, matching the core ethos of CampusQuest.

ideas.pitch: An interactive digital simulation game highlighting campus energy and water conservation challenges specifically tailored for school visitors.
ideas.title: EcoQuest RGIPT
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines gamification and sustainability, echoing successful educational simulators while being grounded in a beginner-friendly format.

ideas.pitch: An offline-friendly practice partner that generates adaptive logic riddles and analytical quizzes to help school students prep for aptitude tests.
ideas.title: QuizMentor AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly supports the foundational quiz round of the event, providing immediate utility to participants preparing for the competition.

ideas.pitch: A simplified collaborative whiteboard designed for young students to structure brainstorms, map out innovation ideas, and present concepts visually.
ideas.title: IdeaCanvas Junior
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the creative problem-solving and ideation phase that young student innovators experience during the workshop stage.

ideas.pitch: A friendly interactive guide and map for school students arriving at RGIPT to navigate venues, workshops, and event schedules seamlessly.
ideas.title: CampusNavi Kids
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate logistical pain point for attendees at the physical venue in Jais, Uttar Pradesh, ensuring high live demo utility.
